description:
Access all the tools you need for data analysis with our comprehensive solution. Start shifting your focus from data to discovery and take advantage of NGS workflows, interpretation and visualization.


Bug fixes
Vulnerabilities fixed in this release include:
- CVE-2026-114820
- CVE-2026-91403
Changes
The bundled Java version is Java 21.0.13.0.3, where we use the JRE from the Azul OpenJDK builds.
Advanced notice
The following will not be available in future release lines (v. 27 and higher):
- The legacy Workbench policy property 'run_on_workbench_when_server_is_available'. The workbench_save_to_server policy property is available to use instead.
- The AGP (legacy) exporter
